messages:
Alice Chen: FYI — Sales just handed a compliance-heavy ask from AcmeHealth. They want SOC2 + HIPAA, 7yr audit log retention, exportable per-tenant audit logs, and BYOK/KMS. Prefer Private VPC. Putting intake here for triage, timeline, and prioritization. Docs: https://redwood.app/notes/acme-compliance-request :eyes:
ComplianceBot: New intake submitted: INC-4217 — AcmeHealth compliance questionnaire attached. Intake form: https://redwood.app/intake/INC-4217 :page_facing_up:
Mateo Rivera: Thanks — quick clarifying Qs: 1) Hosted vs Private? 2) "Exportable" means what format/delivery? 3) Are they asking for immutable cold storage or just long retention?
Alice Chen: They confirmed Private VPC (customer-managed networking). Exportable = periodic S3 export + single-tenant audit bundle (machine-readable, CSV/JSON). They want legal-grade retention (7 years) and KMS BYOK with HSM-backed keys.
Priya Singh: Noted. We'll need a risk assessment and legal sign-off for retention > our default. Also need the filled questionnaire and their acceptance of retention SLAs. Can we get sample logs they expect to export? @Alice
Alice Chen: Uploading their filled packet now: https://redwood.app/files/acme-questionnaire-INC-4217.pdf. They included example syslog schema.
Jordan Li: From an implementation POV: KMS/BYOK spike exists (ENG-987). KMS PoC ~2w, production-ready integration ~4w (including key rotation, policy mapping). Audit-export endpoint likely an S3 push + manifest signing. Will size properly once we confirm formats.
Samir Patel: For Private deployments we also need infra decisions: long-term storage lifecycle (hot->cold), access controls for exported bundles, and egress bandwidth for large exports. Cost modeling required.
Mateo Rivera: Proposed prioritization: mark as P1 if Acme signs a Dedicated/Private onboarding contract (they indicated willingness to pay). Launch criteria (minimum): spec doc, KMS PoC, audit-export API + test harness, data-retention job, legal & security sign-off. Rough ETA: 6-8 weeks after greenlight.
Alice Chen: Acme is comfortable with that timeline if we can commit. They want a written deliverable they can present to their legal infra team.
Mateo Rivera: I'll create the product ticket and owner. Tentative backlog entry: "PROD-2142 — Compliance: Private KMS + 7yr audit export (AcmeHealth)". Will tag @Priya @Jordan @Samir and include intake assets.
ComplianceBot: Created issue PROD-2142: https://redwood.app/issues/PROD-2142 — "Compliance: Private KMS + 7yr audit export (AcmeHealth)"
Priya Singh: :thumbsup: I'll start risk assessment and checklist for SOC2/HIPAA evidence. Need the filled questionnaire to map controls — thanks @Alice.
Jordan Li: I'll schedule the KMS spike in next sprint planning. Rough dev estimate: 3 engineers x 3 weeks for PoC, 2 more weeks for hardening and tests (total ~5w dev).
Mateo Rivera: Next steps: 1) I will flesh out PROD-2142 with acceptance criteria, launch checklist, and QA test prompts. 2) @Priya start risk/legal mapping. 3) @Jordan scope KMS + export endpoints. 4) @Samir run infra/cost analysis. 5) @Alice confirm contract terms (Dedicated + SLA).
Alice Chen: Confirmed contract terms (Dedicated + 6mo SLA). I'll update the issue with the signed LOI.
Mateo Rivera: Great. If everyone agrees: we move to P1 and slot into the next roadmap increment. Please add any blockers to PROD-2142. 
Samir Patel: Adding one note — retention of 7 years means cold-store lifecycle + periodic restore testing (we should include restore drills in acceptance criteria).
Priya Singh: Also logging integrity: add signed manifests for exports and key provenance tracking to the security requirements.
Alice Chen: Thanks all — will follow up with the customer's legal and drop the contract PDF in the issue."
